"""Account corrected V166 owners, original failed smoke and adopted parity once."""
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2'
failed=root.parent/'V166-common-support-routing-v1';motivation_root=root.parent/'V166-support-routing-motivation-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);guard(read(failed/'plan-v1.json'));guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
training=read(root/'status-v1.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert training['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status']=='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
assert set(training['completed'])=={'parity','smoke','train'}
assert set(post['completed'])=={'checkpoint-validation','review','scores','metric-audit','render'}
assert all(v['returncode']==0 for v in post['completed'].values())
owners=[('corrected-training-controller',training['owner'])]+[(n,read(root/f'{n}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for n in ['parity','smoke','train']]
owners += [('corrected-postprocess-controller',post['owner'])]+[(n,v['owner']) for n,v in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners)==10
failure=read(failed/'smoke-failure-v1.json');oldparity=read(failed/'parity-result-v1.json')
assert failure['progress']['counts']==failure['progress']['updates']=={'common-control':2,'routed-common':1}
assert not list((failed/'checkpoints').glob('*.pt'))
owners += [('original-failed-controller',read(failed/'status-v1.json')['owner']),('original-failed-queue',read(failed/'postprocess-status-v1.json')['owner']),
 ('original-parity',oldparity['owner']),('original-failed-smoke',failure['owner'])]
motivation=read(motivation_root/'result-v1.json');assert motivation['root_head_calls']==4 and motivation['head_images']==16
assert motivation['counts']=={'open-V164':2,'closed-V165':2} and motivation['full_parameter_adjoint_evaluations']==8
owners.append(('motivation-probe',motivation['owner']))
assert len(owners)==len({(o['pid'],o['created']) for _,o in owners})==15
records=[]
for stage,owner in owners:
 assert not live(owner),(stage,owner)
 try:
  p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);terminal='PID-reused-original-terminal' if abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])>=.01 else p.status()
 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:terminal='absent'
 records.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':terminal})
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');assert review['component_forwards']==3288 and review['new_prediction_arrays']==review['control_replayed_exact']==1644
paths=set();newpaths=set();controls=0
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
 c=read(binding['path']);assert c['component_forwards']==822
 forward=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 observations=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 assert [r['returned_forwards'] for r in forward]==list(range(1,823)) and observations==c['observations']
 control=c['arm']=='common-control';assert c['adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay']==control
 for row in observations:
  p=Path(row['prediction']['path']);assert p.is_relative_to('/mnt/external') and str(p) not in paths
  paths.add(str(p));assert row['archive_replayed_bit_exact']==control
  if control:controls+=1
  else:newpaths.add(str(p))
assert len(paths)==3288 and len(newpaths)==controls==1644
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert parity['component_forward_evaluations']==0 and parity['adopted_component_forward_evaluations']==56
assert parity['original_parity']==ref(failed/'parity-result-v1.json') and oldparity['component_forward_evaluations']==56
main_calls=oldparity['component_forward_evaluations']+sum(read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+sum(read(root/'train-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+review['component_forwards']
assert main_calls==5364
failed_calls=sum(failure['progress']['counts'].values());calls=main_calls+failed_calls+motivation['root_head_calls'];assert calls==5371
excluded={os.getpid()}|{p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()};matching=[]
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
 if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:continue
 if any(t==str(r) or t.startswith(str(r)+'/') for r in [root,failed,motivation_root] for t in p.info['cmdline'] or []):matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching,matching
output=root/'execution-completion-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'all15-original-corrected-failed-and-motivation-owners-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
 'recorded_owner_count':15,'main_owner_count':10,'failed_trial_owner_count':4,'owners':records,'live_matching_root_argv':matching,
 'head_calls':calls,'main_head_calls':main_calls,'head_image_evaluations':11452,'main_head_images':11424,
 'motivation_root_calls':4,'motivation_head_images':16,'motivation_parameter_adjoint_evaluations':8,
 'failed_prefix_root_calls':failed_calls,'failed_prefix_head_images':12,'adopted_parity_roots':56,'new_parity_roots':0,'parity_leaf_backwards':20,
 'actual_parent_root_calls':0,'actual_DINO_backbone_calls':0,'new_source_constructions':0,'new_sensor_sampler_calls':0,
 'cache_batches_reused':1000,'unique_training_observations_reused':4000,'scientific_stage_failures':1,'full_training_restarts':0,
 'preflight_import_failures':1,'review_root_calls':3288,'control_prediction_replays_exact':1644,'new_prediction_arrays':1644,
 'new_array_bytes':sum(Path(p).stat().st_size for p in newpaths),
 'training_completion':ref(root/'status-v1.json'),'postprocess_completion':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
 'independent_training_units_and_inherited_masks':ref(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json'),'actual_training_objective_audit':ref(root/'training-objective-audit-v1.json'),
 'motivation':ref(motivation_root/'result-v1.json'),'failure':ref(failed/'smoke-failure-v1.json'),'correction':plan['failure_correction'],
 'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
